title: Integrating Triaxial IMU Sensors and Ensemble Learning for Effective Parkinson Disease Severity Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.28602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parkinson disease PD is a progressive neurodegenerative disease that can have a significant impact on motor performance resulting in the appearance of symptoms such as tremors rigidity postural instabilities and bradykinesia. Timely clinical treatment disease management and quality life of the patients are closely linked to early and appropriate identification of PD. Over the past few years the growth of wearable sensor technology and artificial intelligence AI have made it possible to create noninvasive and data driven disease detection methods. This paper proposes a comparative system using artificial intelligence to detect Parkinsons disease by analyzing the motion and tremor data captured by an inertial measurement unit IMU. The data comprises the signals of the acceleration and gyroscope sensors measuring movement in three directions X Y and Z. The signs and symptoms provide helpful information about subtle motor deficits associated

translated_title: 整合三轴IMU传感器与集成学习以实现有效的帕金森病严重程度分类
translated_abstract: 帕金森病（PD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，会对运动功能产生重大影响，导致出现震颤、僵硬、姿势不稳定和运动迟缓等症状。及时的临床治疗、疾病管理和患者的生活质量与早期且适当的帕金森病识别密切相关。近年来，可穿戴传感器技术和人工智能（AI）的发展使得创建无创的、数据驱动的疾病检测方法成为可能。本文提出了一种使用人工智能的对比研究系统，通过分析由惯性测量单元（IMU）捕获的运动和震颤数据来检测帕金森病。该数据包括测量X、Y、Z三个方向运动的加速度计和陀螺仪传感器信号。这些体征和症状为与相关的细微运动缺陷提供了有用的信息。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合三轴IMU传感器（加速度计与陀螺仪）采集的运动和震颤数据与集成学习方法的人工智能系统，用于实现有效的帕金森病严重程度分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an AI-based system that integrates triaxial IMU sensor data (accelerometer and gyroscope) with ensemble learning for effective Parkinson's disease severity classification.
